pages.text: Sets the colors of the text printed from now on.$(br2)The colors are the 16 colors of Minecraft text, from 0 (black) to 15 (white). Background 0 is the color of the screen. A number outside 0 to 15 raises INVALID_ARGUMENT.
$(li)$(1)foreground$() INTEGER: the color of the letters, 0 to 15$(li)$(1)background$() INTEGER: the color behind the letters, 0 to 15 (optional, default 0)
